lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Julia | Lesson 8 -- What Was Happening?

listenings.text: So the recruiter called me on Thursday and I missed it, and I want to tell you why, because it is so stupid. I was on the bus, going home, with my headphones in, listening to music at full volume like an idiot. And behind me two people were arguing about a seat, really loudly, so I turned the music up even more. My phone was in my bag. I did not feel it, I did not hear it, nothing. I saw the missed call forty minutes later. I called back immediately and explained, and honestly they were completely fine about it. But those forty minutes were the longest of my life.

Good morning. A note about what happened during Wednesday's exam. The students were writing the second part when the fire alarm went off, and as you know, everybody had to leave the building. We were outside for twenty-five minutes. Nobody was in danger, and it was a false alarm from the building next door. Now, we are not going to repeat the whole exam. What we are going to do is give everyone those twenty-five minutes back, in a short session next Tuesday, at the same time. Bring nothing. We keep your papers. Thank you.
